item.title: Wilmington International Airport gives all clear after bomb threat sparks evacuation, New Hanover County bomb squad called in
item.description: The terminal at Wilmington International Airport has been evacuated after a bomb threat was made, airport officials said Thursday night.

item.title: VP Vance to visit Rocky Mount, contentious District 1 as Republicans try to pickup seat
item.description: Vice President JD Vance will be in Rocky Mount on Friday and political experts say the location is no coincidence.

item.title: 2 women charged with giving alcohol, marijuana to teen driver before deadly Wayne County crash: ALE
item.description: Two women were arrested Wednesday in connection with a crash in Wayne County last fall that left two teenagers dead, the North Carolina Alcohol Law Enforcement Division said.

item.title: 1 dead, 3 hurt in 4-car crash on Highway 87 and Nursery Road in Harnett County: NCSHP
item.description: A crash involving four vehicles in Harnett County Thursday afternoon left one person dead and three people hurt, the North Carolina State Highway Patrol said.

item.title: Woman shot to death on Backbay Road in Fayetteville, suspect in custody, Cumberland County sheriff says
item.description: A woman was found shot to death on Backbay Road in Fayetteville Thursday night, the Cumberland County Sheriff's Office said.

item.title: Wake County residents weigh in on future growth in Neuse North area
item.description: Residents in a rural unincorporated portion of northern Wake County gathered Thursday to share their concerns and ideas with county planners about how their community should grow in the coming decade.

item.title: Wheelchairs, oxygen tanks, smiles made of yarn: Triangle volunteers crochet dolls for kids with medical conditions, disabilities
item.description: A doll can be a source of comfort for a child, but for kids with medical conditions or disabilities, it can be hard to find a one to really connect with. That's where the nonprofit Feel Better Friends comes in.

item.title: Duke barely holds off feisty Florida State in ACC quarterfinals
item.description: A feisty Florida State squad led the Blue Devils at the half, and the Seminoles made life difficult for Duke in the second half, but Duke did enough to hold off FSU Thursday night in a tournament quarterfinals matchup.

item.title: UNC's late comeback falls short as the Tar Heels lose to Clemson in ACC Tournament quarterfinal
item.description: CHARLOTTE (WNCN) — It was a rough showing for North Carolina men's basketball in the last game of the Atlantic Coast Conference Tournament's quarterfinal round Thursday night, but they nearly made up for it with a late comeback against fifth-seeded Clemson. Ultimately, they came up short, with the fourth-seeded Tar Heels losing to the Tigers [...]

item.title: Cooler Friday ahead of weekend warm-up
item.description: Friday will feel noticeably cooler, with afternoon highs around 60 degrees. The cool air won’t last long, though. By Friday afternoon, winds will shift to the southwest and increase to around 15 mph, helping temperatures climb again heading into the weekend.
